## SPEC: APPROVE

The comparator implements exactly the declared observation-equality contract and nothing more. [compare.rs](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare.rs:96) orders comparisons as specified: identity profile, then source (lines 100–105), initial snapshot (106–108), records in ascending index with rule, charge, before, after (109–127), then length (128–134). [snapshot_difference](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare.rs:138) covers all eight Snapshot fields in the documented enum order (Program via `Arc` deref at line 139 — structural, not pointer, equality; Control, Environment, Frames, StackLimit, RemainingFuel, InitialFuel, Outcome). Program equality is the derived structural equality over ordered functions, parameters, bodies, and entry in [reference_types.rs](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/reference_types.rs:96); frames compare as the complete ordered top-first vector. `TraceView` is borrowed and `TraceDifference` carries only a position, so raw original values remain reachable, as the module docs state and a test exercises. An empty record slice is a present zero-length observation (equal only to itself), never an absent layer. ## QUALITY: APPROVE

The test suite is genuinely independent where it matters: [compare_tests.rs](/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sherlock-trace-compare-20261015/crates/mori-core/src/sherlock/compare_tests.rs:111) compares hand-literalized N01 two-step states (rule 102 charge 1, rule 80 free publication, UInt(7)) against the actual `Machine`, with no evaluator-derived expectations; the literal identity constants are cross-checked against `PROFILE`/`K_SOURCE_SHA256` by that same test. Field coverage is exhaustive over initial (line 195), every record before/after (205), rule/charge (234), intra-snapshot order (255), record order including before-before-after (280), prefix/length both directions plus empty (310), common-prefix-before-length (328), Arc-distinct structural equality (98), function-order sensitivity (383), and raw-value retrieval (370). The Argon classifier's static 28-count error and the failed first workspace classification are disclosed in the audit README rather than hidden, and no expectation was edited to reach GREEN. Minor non-blocking coverage notes: function parameter/body and multi-frame order swaps are covered by derived equality in code but not by dedicated mutations; adding them would strengthen, not change, the result.

No in-repo untrusted consumer was found; whether any future wiring is safe is Argon's call, as is every other security judgment here.
